# Photo Cleaner

> Photo Cleaner is an iPhone and iPad app by Mohamed Elatabany for cleaning up your photo library: swipe left to delete and right to keep. It finds duplicates and similar shots, blurry photos, screenshots and large videos, and sends everything you delete to a Trash Bin you review first. It needs iOS 17 or later, is free to download (100 deletions free, one time) with an optional Photo Cleaner Pro subscription, and processes everything on-device: no account, no photo uploads, no data collection.

Photo Cleaner (App Store name "Photo Cleaner: Swipe Cleanup") is in the Utilities category on the App Store, rated 4.6 out of 5 from 35 ratings on the US App Store (October 2026). Download: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6746700862

## Guides

- [Delete duplicate photos on iPhone](https://getphotocleaner.com/guides/delete-duplicate-photos-iphone.html): Use the free Duplicates album in Photos to merge exact copies, then remove similar shots and keep the best one. Steps for iOS 17, 18 and 26.
- [Free up iPhone storage from Photos](https://getphotocleaner.com/guides/free-up-iphone-storage-photos.html): Free up iPhone storage from Photos, biggest wins first: videos, Live Photos, screenshots, bursts, duplicates and blurry shots. Built-in steps included.
- [Clean up your camera roll fast](https://getphotocleaner.com/guides/clean-up-camera-roll-fast.html): Clean up your iPhone camera roll with the swipe method: one decision per photo, ten minutes a day, safe review before anything is deleted.
- [Delete blurry photos on iPhone](https://getphotocleaner.com/guides/delete-blurry-photos-iphone.html): Photos has no blur filter. Find blurry iPhone photos manually, or flag them with on-device Blur Detection and review before deleting.
- [Delete screenshots on iPhone](https://getphotocleaner.com/guides/delete-screenshots-iphone.html): Bulk-delete screenshots on iPhone from the built-in Screenshots album with drag-to-select, then stop them piling up again. iOS 17, 18 and 26.
- [Find large videos on iPhone](https://getphotocleaner.com/guides/find-large-videos-iphone.html): Photos can't sort by size. Find the biggest videos on your iPhone with built-in tools, or list them largest first and free gigabytes fast.
- [iPhone storage full with iCloud Photos](https://getphotocleaner.com/guides/iphone-storage-full-icloud-photos.html): Device vs iCloud storage, what Optimize iPhone Storage does, why deleting syncs to iCloud, and how Recently Deleted's 30 days work.

## Comparisons

- [Best photo cleaner apps (2026)](https://getphotocleaner.com/compare/best-photo-cleaner-apps-iphone.html): An honest 2026 comparison of Apple Photos, Photo Cleaner, Swipewipe, Slidebox, Cleanup and CleanMy®Phone: swiping, duplicates, blur, large videos.
- [Swipewipe alternative](https://getphotocleaner.com/compare/swipewipe-alternative.html): Like swiping to clean photos? Photo Cleaner adds duplicate grouping, blur detection and largest-files sorting, all on-device. A fair comparison.
- [Slidebox alternative](https://getphotocleaner.com/compare/slidebox-alternative.html): Slidebox is great for sorting albums. Photo Cleaner focuses on clearing space: duplicates, blurry shots and large videos, on-device. Fair comparison.
